english.title: Pedestrian remain within limits of a pelican crossing longer than was necessary
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a pedestrian, remained on the carriageway within the limits of a Pelican crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) longer than was necessary for you to pass over the crossing with reasonable despatch
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 19 of the Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997, section 25(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
IMPORTANT NOTE
The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 are repealed from 22nd April 2016. However, these regulations may still be used for offences relating to Pelican crossings; this is providing the Pelican crossings were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal), by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant failed to pass over the Pelican crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) with reasonable despatch.
